headline: US Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady as Wall Street Closes Higher
summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve maintained benchmark interest rates at its latest meeting, keeping rates in the 3.75% to 4% range. Wall Street stocks gained following the decision, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average rising 0.19%.
why: The Federal Reserve sets U.S. monetary policy, influencing global borrowing costs, asset valuations, and capital flows across international markets.
why_moved: U.S. equities gained slightly after the Federal Reserve opted to hold interest rates steady, reducing near-term rate uncertainty.
